title: A Copy That Was Not a Copy: Implicit Sharing, and the Innocent Read That Makes a Real One
fallback: This lesson is about how Qt containers share their data until somebody writes, so it needs Qt. Lesson 02-15 counts the copies a std::vector makes, which is the same question asked of a container that copies eagerly. Without Qt, do 02-15 and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: reading a shared Qt buffer without copying it, and noticing when it was copied
